package.description: AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings.

en-US.description: AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings.
en-US.longDescription: The Fireflies.ai desktop app is an AI notetaker that captures, transcribes, and summarizes meetings. It provides live transcripts, automatic meeting notes and summaries, instant answers from live meetings and past syncs with AskFred, mid-call AI skills, botless meetings, and real-time sales assistance that searches past meetings and knowledge bases.
en-US.name: Fireflies

zh-CN.description: 录制、转写并总结会议的 AI 会议记录助手。
zh-CN.longDescription: Fireflies.ai 桌面应用是一款 AI 会议记录助手，可捕获、转写并总结会议内容。它提供实时转写、自动会议纪要与总结、基于 AskFred 的实时问答、会中 AI 技能、无机器人会议模式，以及可实时检索过往会议与知识库的销售辅助功能。
